kr-tw-hk-new-p6-skt-q3-2026-results-ko.summary: SK Telecom's own third-quarter 2026 results release. Its AI data centre section says SKT set up SK Hyper (July) and SK Horizon (August) to run the AIDC business, with SK Horizon responsible for infrastructure operation and expansion, and states that SK Horizon is building about 180 MW of new data centres in the Ulsan and Seoul areas ('울산과 서울 지역에 약 180㎿ 규모 신규 데이터센터를 구축 중'). The 180 MW is a combined figure for the Ulsan and Seoul builds, not a capacity for either.

ops-nordics-p6-eqx-q3-2026-earnings-pres.summary: Equinix's Q3 2026 earnings presentation (49 slides), linked from its results release of 28 October 2026 for the quarter ended 30 September 2026. Slide 36, 'Data Center Portfolio Composition - EMEA', lists for the metro Helsinki five IBX data centers: Stabilized HE3, HE4, HE5 and HE6; Expansion HE7; Owned HE5* (subject to long-term ground lease), HE6 and HE7; Leased HE3 and HE4; and for Stockholm three: Stabilized SK1, SK2 and SK3; Owned SK2 and SK3; Leased SK1. The EMEA change summary names no closure or status change in Helsinki or Stockholm, and the slide footnotes say atNorth joint-venture assets are excluded and that the stabilized/expansion/new categorisation is reset annually in Q1. Slide 47 defines Stabilized Data Centers as those whose final expansion or redevelopment phase began operating before 1 January 2025 and Expansion Data Centers as those whose Phase 1 began operating before 1 January 2025 with an expected further phase. Slide 30 reports Q3 2026 cabinets billed and recurring revenues for the 193 stabilized, 52 expansion and 12 new IBX data centers. The presentation thus states that HE3, HE4 and HE5 are operating Equinix IBX data centers in its portfolio for the quarter ended 30 September 2026.
